Subject: Otellytics POC: success criteria, evaluation plan, and next steps

Hi Alex —

Great chat today, thanks for the time. Per our call, I wanted to capture the agreed success criteria, the proposed evaluation plan, and immediate next steps so we have a mutual action plan for the POC. Please confirm or flag anything I missed.

High-level success criteria (you can confirm weights):
- Latency: median 95th-pct token latency < 150 ms for our 512-token queries
- Throughput: sustain 20 concurrent sessions during peak test window
- Accuracy: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers with >= 85% precision on the 50 sample queries you provided
- Cost target: similar or better unit cost than your current vendor (goal: -15% token cost)

Proposed evaluation plan and timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Access & environment setup — Redwood provides a sandbox tenant and access docs (we attached the access guide).
- Week 1: Model onboarding & baseline runs — run the 50 sample queries and capture latency/accuracy metrics.
- Week 2: Integration tests with your vector store and RAG flow; run stress/throughput tests.
- Week 3: Run customer-facing quality review with your SMEs and finalize scorecard.

Ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (sales) — overall POC coordination; Marcus (infra) — technical lead for onboarding and perf tests; Dylan (SRE) — support for environment/setup and scripted runs.
- Otellytics: Alex (POC owner) — product validation and SME review; Jennifer (eng lead) — integration and credentials.

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) Redwood: share sandbox tenant and access guide — MARISSA (today) — attachment: redwood-access-guide.md.
2) Otellytics: confirm dataset access and vector store endpoint + credentials — ALEX (by Fri 9/25).
3) Redwood: schedule 1-hour kickoff with technical team (Marcus, Dylan, Jennifer) — MARISSA (propose slots).
4) Otellytics: confirm success criteria weights and any additional evaluation queries — ALEX (by Fri 9/25).

Attachments included: otellytics-poc-plan-v1.pdf, redwood-access-guide.md, poc-success-metrics.xlsx

If that all looks right I can send calendar invites for the kickoff and provision the sandbox.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
